Definition
[Cyclic branched cover] \group thurston-ch01-coverings Source: thurston:page-0010

For a knot $K$, the $n$-fold cyclic branched cover is obtained from the cover of $S^3-K$ corresponding to \[ \ker \bigl(\pi _1(S^3-K)\longrightarrow H_1(S^3-K)\cong \mathbb Z\longrightarrow \mathbb Z_n\bigr). \] For the trivial knot these covers are $S^3$.
